## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T647 (three fascicles, alt. title 力藏嚴經) is the Sui-period translation by [那連提耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%A3%E9%80%A3%E6%8F%90%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D) (Narendrayaśas, 517–589) of a Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtra extolling the *lì zhuāngyán sānmèi* — a meditative concentration adorned with the bodhisattva's powers (*bala*). Narendrayaśas, having earlier translated [T639](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0276) (the *Yuèdēng sānmèi jīng*) under the Northern Qí, completed T647 toward the end of his career under the Sui.

**Abstract**

[那連提耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%A3%E9%80%A3%E6%8F%90%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D) (Narendrayaśas) was an Indian translator from Magadha who arrived in northern China c. 556. After serving the Northern Qí court he was forced into hiding when Northern Zhōu emperor [周武帝](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%A8%E6%AD%A6%E5%B8%9D) Wǔ issued the proscription of Buddhism in 574; he re-emerged after the Sui restoration of Buddhism by [隋文帝](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9A%8B%E6%96%87%E5%B8%9D) Emperor Wén in 581 and resumed translation work at the Dàxīngshàn sì 大興善寺 in Cháng'ān. T647 is dated by the *[Lìdài sānbǎo jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0011)* (T2034) to this Sui period of his activity (582–589). Date bracket: 585–589, the late phase of his Sui activity, before his death in 589. The text presents the bodhisattva's ten powers (*daśa-bala*) within the framework of *samādhi* practice and is closely related thematically to other power-and-adornment Mahāyāna texts of the period.
